discrepancies.finding: Web guide described deleted top-level pages and appNavigation.tsx; source App.tsx renders Chat and Settings overlay.
discrepancies.resolution: Rewrote guide around current shell and authenticated diagnostics; verified links and restored active attachment constraints and recovery after independent review.

discrepancies.finding: System requirements called Docker universally required while describing remote setup.
discrepancies.resolution: Scoped Compose requirements to the local hub and documented current remote preflight boundaries.

discrepancies.finding: Historical remote bootstrap retained files_home, omitted hub_daemon_url, and did not supply the current authenticated files owner. ROADMAP already settles thin-node direction.
discrepancies.resolution: Removed obsolete executable recipe, preserved nine acceptance obligations and physical evidence requirements, and documented current implementation limitation. Corrected premature needs-decision label/note on existing #19600; original task criteria and human gates preserved.

discrepancies.finding: Tag-order examples disagreed with current manifest versions and recommended routine remote tag deletion.
discrepancies.resolution: Aligned examples with manifest versions and required maintainer inspection before any published-tag recovery.

discrepancies.finding: Admin guide described pack as full-state and omitted destination files-home and identity behavior.
discrepancies.resolution: Documented selected inventory, dry-run limits, explicit identity restoration, restore omissions, and failure recovery.

discrepancies.finding: Guides attributed the five-second server credential-cache refresh to client token distribution.
discrepancies.resolution: Named daemon cache refresh and required clients to reread or receive the replacement token; AuthService.refresh is authoritative.

discrepancies.finding: System requirements described FalkorDB host ports as fixed despite Compose variables and configured Redis port resolution.
discrepancies.resolution: Documented defaults and matching Compose/configuration mappings.

discrepancies.finding: Web rewrite removed active attachment guidance and linked to guides without it.
discrepancies.resolution: Restored concise effective limit and validation-versus-processing recovery instructions; 57 attachment tests pass.
